from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # The solid one-color column separates two noisy binary panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != left_bg and right[r][c] == right_bg else right_bg
             for c in range(len(right[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # A monochrome divider separates two same-sized noisy binary panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Prefer a full uniform row/column which separates equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            a_bg = Counter(v for row in top for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
            b_bg = Counter(v for row in bottom for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
            return [[3 if top[i][j] != a_bg and bottom[i][j] == b_bg else b_bg
                     for j in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    for c in range(w):
        if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            left, right = [row[:c] for row in grid], [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            a_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
            b_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
            return [[3 if left[i][j] != a_bg and right[i][j] == b_bg else b_bg
                     for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('divider not found')
